limitations: All schedules, scores, player annotations and observation timestamps are fixed synthetic test fixtures, not observed NFL data.
Virtual pregame timestamps simulate execution order; these were never forecasts actually issued on those dates.
Probabilities are produced by the unchanged frozen model from synthetic feature states; no probability or coefficient is forced to a desired value.
Scenario pass/fail tests software behavior and arithmetic, not NFL predictive accuracy, model calibration or causal explanations.
All intermediate forecast/evaluation publications occur in a temporary directory and are removed after capture into this explicitly synthetic report.

scenarios.description: A model-derived strong home favorite loses a controlled synthetic game.
A model-derived home underdog beats the strong away favorite.
The model-derived strong home favorite wins.
Kickoff passed, but no verified final result is available.
An explicitly postponed game remains unscored.
A later score correction creates a new result/evaluation version.
A synthetic injury report after cutoff is rejected and cannot change the forecast.
A stale source yields an unavailable forecast without an invented probability.
A reconciliation source outage preserves the prior immutable evidence and pointer.

failures.message: Source unavailable: preserve the last successful operations artifact

scenarios.description: An incomplete earlier result blocks a probability and postgame scoring.
Repeated identical result receipts and reconciliation are idempotent.
Invalid source timing fails generation without changing an existing forecast.

failures.message: Invalid forecast/source time ordering or season

scenarios.description: A game observed in progress does not acquire a fabricated final score.
A verified synthetic tie is recorded and excluded from binary scores.

release_limitations: Current and operations pointers are not a single transaction.

Trusted hosted bundle restoration and durable retention are not wired.
Local dry runs do not prove hosted Actions runtime, billing quotas or Pages environment protection.

final_candidate_credential_scan.scope: Tracked/nonignored source and dist; four finite token/private-key pattern families; no exhaustive secret detection claim

review_fixes: Reject unsupported flow/duplicate/extra YAML triggers, including whitespace-before-colon duplicate keys, in the workflow regression contract.
Report rollback expiry preservation and explicit later virtual review, rather than pretending the earlier rollback was already stale.
Prevent scenario output to arbitrary checkout paths when the checkout itself is under OS temporary storage; two added regressions.
Clarify current-proof scope, future-kickoff count and code-review rather than instrumented action-audit evidence.
open_blockers: Public upstream data-rights review and source-code license decision.
Durable trusted hosted observation-bundle restore/retention not implemented.
Immutable version creation is not crash-atomic; two latest pointers are not transactional; production recovery tooling required.
Hosted runner/Node20 Action runtime, Pages environment reviewer and account quotas/overage controls unverified.
Existing forecast expires before upcoming games; no RC1 refresh authorized or performed.
Partition history before sustained runs hit existing client budgets.
Owner release approval and reconciliation of any additional OSv1.1 controls; model promotion/holdout authority remain separate.
no_prohibited_actions: No fitting/tuning/promotion, holdout execution, deployment, scheduled execution, paid service, account or personal-site change. Supported by code review, no-fit tests, boundary tests and preserved hashes; no claim of exhaustive runtime instrumentation.
